note: Worked-example manifest slice. The real manifest is generated across docs/**/*.md and AI-Memory/**/*.md; this file shows the entries produced by the one chunked chapter, plus one memory-sourced core entry for shape.

chunks.summary: The operator's standard voyage workflow, chapter 4, as retrievable sub-topic leaves.
chunks.read_when: You operate Armada and need the capture-to-close workflow, or one step of it.

chunks.summary: Find or create an objective before dispatch; add acceptance criteria; separate deferred work.
chunks.read_when: You are starting non-trivial work and need a durable record before dispatch.

chunks.summary: Read the target repo rules and history; read the coordination board; record prepared facts and preflight.
chunks.read_when: You are about to dispatch and must confirm the work is real, not already done, and not claimed.

chunks.summary: Implementation vs Audit/Research mode; how mode derives from objective Kind; the objective brief; preflight.
chunks.read_when: You are choosing a mission mode or pipeline, or a report-only voyage armed code Checks unexpectedly.

chunks.summary: armada_dispatch is durable-first; the tenant-scoped admission lease; the dispatch hold; data expiry.
chunks.read_when: You are calling armada_dispatch, or a dispatch returned an admission, hold, or already-dispatched code.

chunks.summary: maxConcurrentVoyages is a ceiling, not a rule to run one at a time; the sibling lane rule and its leases.
chunks.read_when: You are enabling a second lane, or a dispatch was refused lane_busy or waited on a vessel mutex.

chunks.summary: startFromRef cuts the first stage's branch from an accepted tip; both resolution failures are loud.
chunks.read_when: You are re-dispatching from a recover/ ref, or a dispatch failed start_from_ref_missing.

chunks.summary: preferredModel takes a tier or a literal model name; a literal pin is best-effort, not a guarantee.
chunks.read_when: You need a specific model for one mission and must know whether the pin holds.

chunks.summary: An explicit pipeline keeps all stages for Audit/Research; only the core fallback collapses to one stage.
chunks.read_when: A report-only voyage lost its review stages, or you are resolving a pipeline for read-only work.

chunks.summary: A stage proves it contains the upstream commit; stage_base_missing is a provisioning fault, not the stage's.
chunks.read_when: A stage failed stage_base_missing, or a downstream stage looks like it is missing upstream work.

chunks.summary: One bounded description feeds every module; the backstop elides content then reference modules, never the skeleton.
chunks.read_when: A brief reads OverBudget, or you are reasoning about what a captain actually received.

chunks.summary: Authorization policy renders verbatim in every brief with fixed hard limits; the refusal classifier and re-route.
chunks.read_when: You are setting an authorization policy, or a mission was recorded as a policy refusal.

chunks.summary: preparation.executionRequirements are checked against the captain launch environment, not just an Admiral-readable path.
chunks.read_when: A dispatch was blocked with an execution_* finding, or a mission needs a runtime or licensed context.

chunks.summary: Test "is it safe to act?" by the FINISHED set, never the busy set; a status added later then reads as active.
chunks.read_when: Always, before restarting the Admiral, rebuilding its image, or reclaiming docks.

chunks.summary: Subscribe to the watcher, not a foreground poll; signals reach a Pending stage only; the three-signal stall rule.
chunks.read_when: You are monitoring a live voyage, deciding whether a captain stalled, or sending a Mail/Nudge.

chunks.summary: The host interlock; the Judge PASS real-signal gate; arming, staleness, supersession; resolve every failed Check.
chunks.read_when: You are creating or reading Checks, or a Judge PASS was held or rejected over a Check.

chunks.summary: A native reward-hacking Check on .NET vessels; added-line rules, FAIL vs WARN, and per-site slop-allow markers.
chunks.read_when: A Slop Check failed, or you must know what the reward-hacking gate flags and how to suppress a byte-exact case.

chunks.summary: The DoD gate skips a read-only no-commit mission and builds (and conditionally tests) every declared consumer.
chunks.read_when: A producer change may break a sibling consumer, or a gate failed consumer_tests_failed or consumer-build.

chunks.summary: Judge follow-ups are durable; the landing-mode table; LocalMerge drift and the recover branch; merge-queue verification.
chunks.read_when: You are reviewing a mission, processing a merge entry, or a landing reported diverged or not-found.

chunks.summary: The six steps to close an objective: link voyages, Checks, release, incidents; record deferred work and the outcome.
chunks.read_when: A voyage landed and you are closing its objective.

chunks.summary: Read papercut reports on a schedule; the distinct-captain count is the signal; route by category; keep promotion manual.
chunks.read_when: A voyage closed, or it is the weekly sweep, and you are triaging captain friction reports.

chunks.summary: An opt-in objective tree for one large effort; optional fair-share scheduling; the five operating rules.
chunks.read_when: You are running or scheduling a multi-slice campaign, or reading armada_campaign_status.

chunks.summary: An operator owns its host-side helpers' full lifecycle; the bounded spawn-helper launcher; strict MCP delivery; one owner per key.
chunks.read_when: You are spawning or managing bounded host-side helpers, or a helper has no Armada tools.

chunks.summary: What must never reach a repository; the pre-push scan list; the owner approval gate. Memory-sourced core.
chunks.read_when: Always. Core rule; never retrieval-gated. Shown to prove the manifest spans docs and memory.
